name: Kenai Peninsula Fish Habitat Partnership NFHP funding

funder.name: Kenai Peninsula Fish Habitat Partnership (National Fish Habitat Partnership)

summary: National Fish Habitat Partnership money for projects that protect and restore freshwater and marine fish habitat in Kenai Peninsula Borough watersheds, submitted by or with the support of a partner, with a 1:1 nonfederal match.
reporting: Interim and annual reports to USFWS and KPFHP; federal grant registrations (SAM.gov, ASAP, GrantSolutions).

eligibility.rule: Addresses at least one National Conservation Priority
Addresses a highest-rated potential threat in the KPFHP Conservation Action Plan
Is submitted by or supported by a partnership member
Includes local or regional community outreach or education
Completes the funded project within two years of receiving the agreement

co_finance.applies_to: Projects not led by a Tribe

geography.quote: KPFHP's mission is to protect, maintain, restore, and enhance fish habitat within Kenai Peninsula Borough watersheds.

access.quote: Project applications should also be submitted by a KPFHP partner or must have direct support from a partner.

amount.quote: There is no maximum funding level, however we prefer funding projects in the range of $10,000 - $50,000.

co_finance_required.quote: Additionally, a 1:1 nonfederal match is required for projects, except tribal projects (see details below).

reporting.quote: provide interim and annual reports to the USFWS and KPFHP

eligibility.quote: Projects must address at least one National Conservation Priority:
Does the project address one or more of the highest rated potential threats to fish habitat identified in KPFHP's Conservation Action Plan?
Is the project submitted by or supported by a partnership member of the Kenai Peninsula Fish Habitat Partnership?
All projects must include an outreach or education component that includes the local or regional community.
All project proposals must include a monitoring plan.
Funded projects must be completed within two years of receiving the agreement.

co_finance.quote: Grant funds must be matched 1:1 with non-federal funds, with an exception for Indian Tribes. Non-federal match can include cash and/or in-kind labor, materials, or equipment, as long as there are no federal ties to those funds.

after_award.quote: provide interim and annual reports to the USFWS and KPFHP.
